```{=html}
<template id="tpl-explorer">
  <fieldset class="toolbar">
    <a class="toolbar-link" href="#">File</a>
    <a class="toolbar-link" href="#">Edit</a>
    <a class="toolbar-link" href="#">View</a>
    <a class="toolbar-link" href="#">Help</a>
  </fieldset>
  <div class="explorer-panes">
    <div class="explorer-tree-pane">
      <ul class="tree-view" id="explorer-tree" style="height: 100%; overflow-y: auto;"></ul>
    </div>
    <div class="explorer-content-pane">
      <ul class="file-explorer" id="explorer-content"></ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```
